notes.title: Backrooms Exploration Update v1.3 “The Renewal” Update out now!
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Backrooms Exploration The Renewal v1.3 Update Now Live![/b][/u][/h1]
[h3][u][b]LIMINAL MODE COMING IN UPDATE V1.4!![/b][/u][/h3]
[h3][i](Game has been updated heavily so previous saves of the game may not work correctly)[/i][/h3]

We have completely revamped the game with updated graphics, better looking levels, improved sound effects, better game mechanics all for a smoother player experience! [b]Liminal Mode will be releasing in the next update v1.4![/b]

[u][b]General Fixes –[/b][/u]
[u][b]Visual[/b][/u]
- Removed Pixel Dissolve Effect (TV Moving Static)

notes.title: Backrooms Exploration - Revamp v1.2
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]Backrooms Exploration - Revamp v1.2[/b][/u][/h2]

Thank you for all the support on our game Backrooms Exploration! We have updated the game to make it more user friendly and added and removed features to make the game look way better! The patch notes for the game are below!

[i]If you haven't heard already, Backrooms Liminal Mode will be a standalone free game! This will enable us to provide the best experience possible for players and allow more of you to play it as it will be FREE![/i]

[h3][b][u]Patch Notes[/u][/b][/h3]
[u]Player:[/u]
- Player Movement increased
- Running/Sprinting is now a toggle. Press SHIFT to sprint instead of holding

[u]In-Game Graphics:[/u]
- Turned down VHS Filter [i](less static)[/i]

[u]Quality of Life Features[/u]
- Information Screen [i](Level loading screen)[/i] last longer
- Liminal info screen updated [i](Main Menu)[/i]
- Updated all in-game descriptions
- Credits page updated

[i]Extra bug fixes/Quality of life changes[/i]
[b][i]Added Steam Achievements [/i][/b]

notes.title: BACKROOMS EXPLORATION THE OVERHAUL UPDATE
notes.content:
[h3]BACKROOMS EXPLORATION THE OVERHAUL UPDATE[/h3]

[h2](SAVES HAVE POTENTIAL TO BE RESET. THIS WILL BE THE ONLY TIME THIS HAPPENS AS IT IS NEEDED TO ENABLE FUTURE UPDATES AND MAKE THE GAME BETTER! WE HOPE YOU UNDERSTAND)[/h2]

General Fixes
-	Jumpscares Volume Lowered
-	TESTBUILD.EXE changed to BackroomsExploration.EXE
-	Changed Paper image/text in-game
-	Added Instructions to Puzzles (Mini Games such as Pick-locking)
-	Can Exit Puzzles with ‘R’ Key
-	Added UI to help the player distinguish puzzles they need to interact with
-	Added Instructions to Puzzles
-	Updated Diary text
-	Removed Unnecessary Item Descriptions
-	Gave Items simple names
-	Player Run Speed Increase 350 > 1000
-	Player Walk Speed Increase 150 > 500
-	Keys now only require you to right click to open doors
-	Added Basic Options Settings
-	Fixed all Escape Instructions to make it easier and clearer (Paper at the start of levels)
-	Changed Main Menu Graphics
-	Added Resource Bucket to every level

LEVEL 0 –
-	Fixed Walls Bound Scales

LEVEL 1 –
-	Fixed Overlapping Textures, Items, and Actors

LEVEL 2 –
-	Lowered Puzzle 1 Gas Damage

LEVEL 3 –
-	Fixed Walls Bound Scales

LEVEL 4 –
-	Changed Lighting Colour
-	Fixed PC Puzzle Bugged Text

LEVEL 5 –
-	Updated Escape Instructions

LEVEL 6 –
-	Fixed Information Screen 

LEVEL 7 –
-	Radar Scanner Instructions Added

LEVEL 8 -
-	Fixed Walls Bound Scales
-	Fixed Information Screen Misspelling

LEVEL TUTORIAL (104) –
-	Fixed Post Process Bug (Room Lighting Changing from dark to light)
-	Fixed Information Screen
